name: Johor Plantations Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团没有新增或退出业务板块，主要动态是持续披露上游月度产量，并与 PIJ Holdings 的 MOU 多次更新但无实质进展。上游产量同比有所下降，第三季度鲜果串产量同比下降11.86%。
overview_en: In 2026, the group did not add or exit any business segment. Its main activities were ongoing monthly upstream production disclosures and repeated updates on the MOU with PIJ Holdings, which showed no material development. Upstream production declined year-on-year, with fresh fruit bunch output down 11.86% year-on-year in the third quarter.

segments.name: 上游
segments.note: 持续披露月度及季度棕油、鲜果串和棕仁产量，第三季度产量同比下滑。
segments.note_en: Continued monthly and quarterly disclosures of crude palm oil, fresh fruit bunch and palm kernel production, with third-quarter output declining year-on-year.

actions.title: MONTHLY PRODUCTION FIGURES (MINING / PLANTATION / TIMBER)
actions.text_en: Announced October 2026 production: crude palm oil 29,968.04 MT, fresh fruit bunch 146,312.46 MT (own production 111,714.75 MT, outside purchase 34,597.71 MT), palm kernel 7,842.70 MT.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 披露截至2026年9月30日季度产量：棕油83,779.25公吨，鲜果串411,942.92公吨，棕仁21,838.95公吨；鲜果串同比减少11.86%。
actions.text_en: Disclosed quarterly production for the quarter ended 30 September 2026: crude palm oil 83,779.25 MT, fresh fruit bunch 411,942.92 MT, palm kernel 21,838.95 MT; fresh fruit bunch decreased 11.86% year-on-year.
